result.title: Efficient contextual partial monitoring with general function approximation
result.summary: We study finite stochastic partial monitoring (PM) games with side information, a paradigm of sequential learning with partial feedback. On each round $t \in [T]$, both player and environment observe a context and player chooses an action and environment simultaneously chooses an outcome. The player neither observes the outcome nor the loss; instead, they only observe a feedback symbol which is partially informative about the outcome. We utilize the Estimation-to-Decisions (E2D) meta-algorithm of Foster et al.(2021) to design E2D.PMSide, a computationally efficient framework for contextual partial monitoring, which uses an online regression oracle to efficiently estimate the outcome distributions based on historical (context, action, feedback symbol) tuples. Since the exploration rule given by the original E2D algorithm is intractable to compute, we propose two computationally efficient exploration rules that achieve optimal regret orders in $T$: in the globally observable setting, our exploration rule is based on $ε$-greedy, while in the locally observable setting, our exploration rule uses inverse gap weighting (Foster & Rakhlin, 2020), which was previously only known to be effective in the bandit setting. We show that a variant of E2D.PMSide named OE2D.PMSide can be combined with offline regression oracles to give an efficient algorithm with optimal regret when the contexts are drawn independently from a fixed distribution. We evaluate our algorithm on a synthetic label-efficient prediction game and an LLM routing task, in which a learner decides from prompt, uncertainty, and internal state features whether to escalate a query from a weak model to a strong one. We show that our method has superior performance to prior approaches.

AI.brief_summary: 研究带辅助信息的上下文部分监测问题，基于 E2D 元算法提出计算高效的 E2D.PMSide，用在线回归预言机估计结果分布，并以 ε-greedy 与 inverse gap weighting 两种探索规则达到最优 regret，在合成任务和 LLM 路由任务上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 部分监测刻画了「付出代价只能获得部分反馈」时的决策，可能为 LVR 中 LOOK/STOP 与视觉证据获取、信息价值的权衡提供形式化参考；其 LLM 路由实验按不确定性与内部状态特征决定是否升级模型，与动态计算分配或有联系，可供核查。
